data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error (LLMResponseError) in the qwen model during the PKGBUILD file review, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully completed the review and found the package safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete the PKGBUILD file review due to an LLMResponseError.
learnings: Transient LLM API errors during file review should be handled via retries or fallback to the initial parse results if available, rather than failing the entire audit and triggering an inconclusive verdict.
